auth:
  none: {}
requests:
  - id: submit
    method: POST
    path: /api/v1/submit
  - id: poll
    method: GET
    path: /api/v1/status
  - id: fetch
    method: GET
    path: /api/v1/result
    produces_events: true
response:
  decode: json
  events_at: response.body.events

  none: {}

  async_job:
    submit:
      step: submit
    poll:
      step: poll
      complete_when: {eq: {path: cursor.status, value: "done"}}
    fetch:
      step: fetch
    on_complete:
      cursor_update:
        kind: use_now
        event_time:
          path: created_at
